data.name: Slushi & Cheezborger
data.description:
(SLUSHI)
Appearance
Slushi is a mint-green and teal fox with turquoise accents on her ears and tails followed by white accents in the center, as well as black leggings with protruding teal pads, which makes them mistakable for markings. She has a white sclera, turquoise irises, teal pupils and black eyelashes.

Overview
At first, Slushi may have seemed like a "Little Miss Perfect", but that isn't the case. She is a happy-go-lucky nerdy weeb type, as she loves cosplaying, conventions, anime, and is a great artist and fanfiction writer. She is also into romance, as she ships Fwench Fwy and Iscream even though they appear to be rivals. Slushi also has some silly interests, such as wanting to be short or liking hydraulic presses, finding it oddly satisfying.

Her interest in some things can be seen as obsessive, though. Such as her blowing all her money on anime merch the first chance she gets, giving lengthy thesis statements about anime, and gushing excessively about a show with tons of violence in it.

Slushi also has mental health issues. It's shown that she regularly avoids her problems instead of facing them, and Episode 226 confirms that she suffers from anxiety.

Compared to her friends, Slushi is very "realistically normal". While the rest of the main cast have magical or world-bending powers, Slushi is so normal to the point where someone exactly like her could easily exist in real life.

The music track that plays in most episodes for which Slushi is the main character is "Garden Party", composed by Andrew Cottee.

Food Name Origin
Slushi's name is a pun on slushies. Her appearance also resembles a slushy, being covered in blue. This is hinted by her phone case.

Abilities
Vanishing
It is confirmed in Episode 446 that Slushi vanishing in Episode 158 is an ability she got from being in contact with Chikn too often.

Relationships
Chikn Nuggit
Chikn Nuggit admires Slushi, mostly due to her tall physique and beauty. However, Chikn possibly is scared of her to an extent, as he watches a very violent TV show with her, which alarms him. The first time she ever got mad at and scolded Chikn was when he tried to chew on one of her shoes via his ASMR.

Cheezborger
Cheezeborger looks up to Slushi a lot, thinking that she is the image of perfection and sees her as an idol. However, Slushi wishes to be shorter like Chee. Overall, they still get along very well.

Iscream
They seem to be friends, as Slushi drew a humanized version of Iscream. The one thing they have in common is how they both like Bezel. Slushi even points out that they have similar taste. She's also willing to confess some things to Iscream, admitting they think clowns are hot.

Fwench Fwy
Slushi and Fwy seem to get along well, as they were chatting together before Iscream came along. Slushi also finds their rivalry with Iscream to be romantic. In Episode, after Slushi showed Fwench Fwy her favorite TV series, "Emperor of Stolen Hearts", the wish dragon developed a crush on Gertrud, and they asked the fox about her number of appearances in the show. In Episode 442, when she asked Fwench Fwy to grant her wish of turning the male character from her drawing real, they refused as they said that they would never waste their magic on anything what she requested. In Episode 533, she asked them whether or not Bezel is gone to do anything bad.

Sody Pop
Baby's First Sparkle Dog, I love them!

Slushi, Episode 83, Who finds Sody's "Mary Sue" OC endearing
Slushi is Sody Pop's main babysitter. So, the two have lots of interaction. She is very supportive of Sody Pop, probably due to Sody being so young, especially when he tries making anything artistic. (due to Slushi having the same geeky interests) In a particular episode, Sody Pop and Slushi were creating OCs together. Upon Sody finishing his, she couldn't help but find it endearing and complimented Sody Pop’s OC and was proud of him. But at the Comic-Con during the interview, she and the rest of the attendees except Hawt Saus were very shocked at Sody's language.

Cofi
When Slushi first saw Cofi, the fox becomes fascinated by the sheep in wolf's clothing to the point of complimenting her stellar craftsmanship skills. Even Cofi said to herself that Slushi understands her.

Bezel
When the Embodiment of Time first met Slushi and Chikn, she quickly becomes fascinated by Bezel to which she refers to him as one of the "Sexymen". She and Iscream even talk about how hot Bezel is. In Episode 375, she started admiring his cat form. In Episode 497, she invited Bezel to draw with her and Sody. In Episode 533, Slushi assumed that Bezel might do something bad when she asked Fwench Fwy about him. In Episode 539, while Slushi is still upset about Bezel's wrongdoings, she was flattered when he says that his design was a "Slushi-original".



Milkshek
She's one of her friends that loses boyfriends. She was annoyed when she saw her dating Old Pea.

Trivia
Slushi is one of three characters to have their gender confirmed to be female, with the others being Cheezborger and Cofi.
Every member of the Main Cast has one other member they have a strong positive relationship with. Slushi is this with Sody Pop. Slushi finds Sody endearingly precious, and the two are shown to be very supportive of each other.
Slushi was originally designed as a taller, more slim pink fox with more narrow eyes, and had a sassier personality.
The motivation behind her design change was to make her "more relatable to younger audiences".
Slushi seems to have been specifically tailor-made to be a good representation of the general demographic of the series. And it worked, as many fans view her as the most relatable of the main cast.
A nerd from the late 2010's era of the Internet, who is massively into Fandom culture, drawing, conventions, social media, and various forms of media such as TV shows and anime. And she also suffers from anxiety.
She is also the only main character to not have any magical or supernatural abilities at all, which might have been a major factor in making her a relatable character. Being so realistically normal, compared to the rest of the cast being more cartoonish, makes it easier for someone to relate to her.
Slushi is Kyra Kupetsky's favorite character to draw.
Despite being the first new main character to appear after the show's beginning, Slushi has the lowest number of episode appearances out of the entire main cast, at only 54.
Slushi also has the record for being the main character with the longest time without lines (33 episodes), She doesn't appear for 28 episodes between Episode 193 and Episode 221 and then she doesn't have lines until episode 225.
With the exception of Bezel, she appears to be the tallest of the main cast, emphasized in a few episodes.
She's the second of two confirmed bisexual characters in the show, the first one being Cheezborger.
In Episode 264, it's revealed that Slushi wears leggings.
The crying Slushi face that appears at the end of Episode 270 is a reference to this meme picture of a cat screaming.
When Slushi makes her sound in Episode 250, the sound is the same sound from Episode 270, but it's high pitched.
There's a real life DJ and YouTuber called Slushii.
She says that she prefers to drink water over soda, but she seems to enjoy ramune.
She and Cofi are the only two main characters who have not made Cheezborger shriek.
Slushi has a credit card, revealed in Episode 389, her credit card number is 0110 1000 0110 1001, and it expires in December 2026, shown in the image in Episode 389 of her credit card.
These numbers in binary code say "Hi".


Cheezborger:

Appearance
Cheezborger is a calico cat with white fur and gray and orange spots all over her. She also wears a beige hat resembling a cheeseburger, with white sesame seeds and a patty, a tomato, a lettuce leaf and some cheese. On top of her hat there is a pickle on a stick, which is revealed to be some sort of antenna that keeps her alive. Under her hat there is a cage with a miniature version of herself inside.

A very friendly and kind feline. Chee is supportive of Chikn, admires Slushi, and is fond of taking care of Sody Pop. 

Cheezborger is quite ordinary compared to her friends. She is often weirded out by the antics of Chikn Nuggit, is fazed by Slushi being obsessive over her interests, and she is easily scared by Iscream. Cheezborger also lacks self-confidence, asking Chikn if she's chubby and wishing to be more like Slushi.

Iscream
Due to Iscream's demonic nature, Cheezborger is easily scared. This most likely occurs when Iscream is doing something related to biblically accurate angels. Iscream also likes scaring her on purpose, although, it's in a friendly sort of way, as nothing indicates that the two have bad blood. Over time they seem to have a better friendship, since Iscream was the first character Cheezborger confided in about her feelings for Cofi. But after she tells Iscream she succeeded and now is in a relationship with Cofi, Iscream gets kind of confused.

Slushi
Cheezborger looks up to Slushi a lot, thinking that she is the image of perfection and sees her as an idol. However, Slushi wishes to be shorter like Chee. Overall, they still get along very well. She is also very supportive to Chee.

Fwench Fwy
Chee and Fwench Fwy get along well, as they were chatting together before Iscream came along. Cheezborger also finds their rivalry with Iscream to be odd. She is still interested in their relationship. In one episode she asks why Fwench Fwy was sitting in a circle of salt and seemed sad to hear that Fwench Fwy was mad at Iscream. Fwench Fwy is also very protective to her. In a later episode she asks if Iscream and Fwench Fwy are going to get married they tell her there going to need more time Fwench Fwy is lighthearted about it, but Iscream cracks a joke which makes Chee upset Fwench Fwy then scolds Iscream for making her cry.

Sody Pop
Sody and Chee somewhat get along. During their first interaction, Sody asked why Cheezborger has her name, to which she replies. Telling him about her Cheeseburger hat. Then she asks him why his name is Sody Pop, and he explodes making her scream. Cheezborger once made fun of Sody Pop’s voice, infuriating him.

Hawt Saus
Hawt Saus and Chee are not on very good terms with each other, and don't have many interactions. In one episode Hawt Saus accidentally makes Cheezborger cry after calling her and Chikn dumpster fires. In a later episode, he asks Chee and Cofi if they are dating, and ends up feeling jealous of them as a result.
